title: Frukt Cyder Peach & Apricot 100ml E-liquid
description: Inhale Summer with this sublime fruit cider vape from Frukt. Sweet, tender peaches are perfectly balanced with bright, tangy apricots and sparkling cider for a luscious all-day vape bursting with sunshine. This convenient 100ml nicotine-free shortfill bottle comes with 20ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape to your liking. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered sub-ohm tanks and mods
